positive: 使用 $ai-company-research 调研一家公司的业务、技术、财务、商业质量和风险。
快速查一下某科技公司现在做什么、核心技术、融资或财务、怎么赚钱和主要风险。
结合最新年报和中报，对一家上市公司做业务、研发、商业模式与财务基本面调研。
研究某品牌、境内运营公司和海外控股主体的关系，做一份集团级公司报告。
评估一家新软件供应商的经营、客户、技术、财务稳定性与公开风险。
把一家公司的业务报告、技术报告、财务商业质量和风险整合成一份可追溯的 HTML 报告。
下周见客户，先查清它的业务、采购信号、技术栈、决策链并准备现场问题。
我要拜访一家基金，分析基金阶段、已投项目、出手节奏、合伙人与我方匹配。

negative.prompt: 我下周面试某公司 AI 产品经理，JD 在附件里，做面试作战地图。
我已经拿到这家公司 25K 的 offer，接、谈还是拒？
拆解某 App 的用户、功能、体验和会员定价。
分析某公司的专利布局、IPC、专利族和 FTO 风险。
只查这家公司的注册地址和成立时间。
分析中国企业级大模型市场未来五年规模。
读取内部 Excel，计算各业务线毛利率。
把昨天的客户录音整理成会议纪要。

hero_queries.prompt: 快速调研一家未上市 AI 初创公司，核实主体、当前业务、付费方、技术证据、公开融资或财务线索、近一年变化和三个风险。没有公开营收就明确说明，不要把融资或估值写成营收。
expected: mode=company and depth=quick
private-company financial limitations are explicit
company claims and verified facts are separated
the report uses the five company modules in one integrated deliverable
business and technology sections are independently understandable
the operating-chain matrix links product, payer, delivery, technology, monetization and sources

hero_queries.prompt: 对一家上市软件公司做标准档公司调研，以最新年报和已发布中报或季报为真源，分析业务线、收入结构、研发、商业模式、竞争和风险。
expected: financial period, currency, unit and consolidation scope are explicit
official filings support material numbers
segments and comparable periods are not mixed
derived metrics are reproducible
business, technology and financial narratives agree with the operating-chain matrix

hero_queries.prompt: 对一个跨境互联网集团做深度公开信息调研，先区分海外控股主体、境内运营法人和主要品牌，再分析业务、技术、公开财务、变现、竞争与监管风险。
expected: entity tree precedes analysis
group, legal-entity and brand data are not merged without evidence
conflicting estimates retain source and scope
major conclusions include counterevidence
each material product line maps to payer, delivery, technology, monetization and evidence

hero_queries.prompt: 调研某集团旗下运营子公司，区分子公司自身业务与母公司合并财务，不能把集团收入直接归给子公司。
expected: market_status=subsidiary
parent and target-entity scopes are explicitly separated
undisclosed subsidiary financials remain unknown
group evidence is not silently allocated to the subsidiary

hero_queries.prompt: 快速研究一家非营利产业研究机构，说明主体、项目、技术能力、资金或预算公开性、合作网络与风险，不套用上市公司利润表。
expected: market_status=institution
the applicable funding or budget basis is explained
inapplicable company metrics are marked rather than fabricated
public sources or explicit gaps cover every core dimension

hero_queries.prompt: 调研一家只公开了产品页面和招聘信息的私营软件公司。仍需给出技术报告，但不能凭功能或岗位关键词猜它的系统架构、底层模型、数据流和自研比例。
expected: the technology report remains present and independently readable
product capabilities are separated from implementation evidence
recruiting and marketing are treated only as signals or company claims
unknown architecture, model, data flow and make-versus-buy boundaries stay unknown

hero_queries.prompt: 把公司调研交付为一份 Markdown 和一份单文件 HTML。HTML 要白底柔黑、系统字体、无渐变无阴影无 emoji，业务和技术章可独立读，移动端与 A4 打印可用。
expected: one Markdown source produces one integrated HTML report
exactly five company H2 modules are present
the HTML uses border and spacing hierarchy without gradients, shadows or emoji
semantic navigation, keyboard access, mobile overflow handling and print styles are present

hero_queries.prompt: 下周要见一家制造业客户，做标准档拜访前调研：先建立公司底图，再分析真实需求、采购信号、决策链、我方切入、最小验证、双向问题与会议议程。
expected: mode=client and depth=standard
company facts and opportunity statements are separated
decision chain and minimum validation are actionable
no job interview or candidate content appears

hero_queries.prompt: 准备拜访一家基金，核实管理主体、基金规模与募集口径、投资阶段、票面、近期案例、出手节奏、决策合伙人和我方匹配。
expected: mode=investor and depth=standard
target, committed, paid-in and AUM concepts are not mixed
portfolio conflicts and decision process are covered
no offer or interview-prep content appears

hard_gates: all modes: entity and reporting scope are explicit
all modes: material claims are traceable to real sources
all modes: listed-company numbers use official filings
all modes: private-company missing financials are not fabricated
all modes: facts, company claims, estimates, inferences and unknowns are separated
company mode: one integrated report contains exactly five H2 modules
company mode: business and technology reports are independently understandable without duplicate files
company mode: material product lines map product, payer, delivery, technology, monetization and sources, with gaps left explicit
company mode: the operating-chain matrix, overview, business, technology and financial analysis do not contradict each other
company mode: technology implementation and architecture are not inferred when evidence supports only product capabilities or investment signals
all modes: no job interview, offer, product-only, or dedicated patent-search, IPC, patent-portfolio or FTO deliverable is inserted
HTML delivery: Markdown and HTML contain the same report
company HTML delivery: it is responsive, keyboard accessible, printable and contains no gradients, box shadows or emoji
non_company_judging: client and investor hero queries use their expected assertions plus all-modes and applicable HTML hard gates; they do not use the company five-module rubric
pass_rule: score >= 85 and no hard gate fails
